source_snapshot.procedure: Observe five physical PSU conditions: off/unplugged LED off; fault solid amber; normal solid green; standby blinking green; cord absent while backfed from other sources blinking amber; collect photos/logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: LED behavior matches the system specification.
source_snapshot.script: No command; 10 attended/10 machine minutes; unique row/code/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO; correctly requires a person to observe and photograph physical color/blink and cable state but omits electrical/redundancy safety.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY/CRITICAL; defines per-state visual evidence, qualified electrical handling, load/redundancy gates, safe stimuli and restoration.

old_problem: The historical review left a coherent five-state manual LED table pending for exact PSU/feed identity, load/redundancy calculation, safe state stimuli and numeric blink oracle even though these can be signed execution parameters without changing the source's physical coverage.
disposition_reason: The Master supplies all five operating states and their visible LED mappings. ED-03/07/09/13/18/20 permit PSU population, feed topology, survivor load, approved stimulus, cadence and final state as runtime configuration while requiring real visual evidence and qualified handling. Unsupported states may be N/A only with authoritative PSU/platform specification. The review therefore defines a safe per-bay matrix and restoration sequence; no software telemetry or improvised fault replaces physical observation.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2217, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2218 / Wistron-BMC Sanity-00001-V002 / df0ea4b9de241da5 was directly read from XLSX and its historical record.
Bind exact SUT, PSU bay/PN/serial/firmware and AC feed/outlet; calculate survivor capacity and measured load before altering a feed or contribution.
Preserve the five literal mappings: off/unplugged→off, fault→solid amber, normal→solid green, standby→blinking green, cord absent/backfed→blinking amber.
For each state use only a vendor-approved physical fixture, supported control or known approved module; never create faults by shorting, obstruction, connector abuse or guesswork.
Video duration must prove solid versus blinking and signed frequency/duty cycle on the exact bay; BMC/input/output telemetry is corroboration only.
Restore full redundancy/baseline between hazardous states and after the matrix; stop on overload, wrong PSU, arc/odor/heat or shutdown.
A state is N/A only when authoritative PSU/platform specification proves it unsupported; missing fixture or inconvenience is not N/A.
No cord/PSU manipulation, fault/standby/backfeed stimulus, query, photo/video, retry, recovery or DUT action was executed.

test_case.test_name: Per-PSU five-state electrical condition and physical LED color/cadence validation
test_case.purpose: Verify each in-scope PSU's local indicator uniquely represents off/unplugged, fault, normal, standby and cord-absent/backfed conditions with the required off, solid amber, solid green, blinking green and blinking amber patterns while the system remains within its safe power envelope.
required_package: SUT PSU population with bay/PN/serial/firmware and AC feed/outlet map
Measured load, redundancy mode and survivor-capacity calculation for every manipulated state
Vendor-approved safe stimulus for all five conditions or authoritative unsupported-state proof
LED color plus blink frequency/duty-cycle and observation-duration oracle
Qualified electrical operator, maintenance authorization, aborts, full-redundancy restoration and recovery
test_case.test_command: For each signed PSU bay and supported state, the qualified operator confirms target/feed/load capacity, establishes only the approved condition, records synchronized video long enough to identify color and solid/blink cadence plus BMC/PSU input/output/current/power evidence, then restores baseline/full redundancy and verifies health before the next state. Unsupported conditions are recorded N/A only with cited PSU/platform specification. Preserve SEL/host events throughout and stop at the first safety or identity anomaly.
test_case.expected_result: For every required bay and supported condition, the exact physical LED matches the five-state specification and cadence, corroborating electrical/BMC state is correct, no overload/shutdown/thermal/electrical fault outside the intended state occurs, and full redundancy is restored after each applicable manipulation.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS only when exact bay/feed/state proof, real time-based LED evidence and signed color/cadence oracle match for all required supported states and restoration succeeds. Wrong color/cadence, ambiguous state, overload, unexpected shutdown/fault or failed restoration is FAIL. Missing map/stimulus/oracle is BLOCKED at execution. N/A requires authoritative unsupported-feature proof; BMC status or still image alone cannot PASS blink states.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until bay/feed map, survivor-load calculation, state-specific safe stimuli, LED cadence oracle, operator authorization and recovery are signed.
Qualified electrical operator owns all physical actions; never short, obstruct cooling, abuse connectors or improvise a fault/backfeed condition.
Name and verify the exact bay/feed before every action; restore full redundancy and confirm health after each hazardous state.
Stop on overload, arc/odor/heat, wrong PSU, unexpected shutdown, fan/power anomaly or ambiguous LED; no automatic repeat or retry.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and SUT/PSU bay PN/serial/firmware/feed map
Approved five-state stimulus plan or authoritative unsupported-state N/A proof
Per-state synchronized video proving exact bay, color and solid/blink cadence
Baseline/full-redundancy restoration, anomaly/recovery and engineer-verdict record
test_case.recovery: On overload, unexpected shutdown, electrical/thermal anomaly, wrong identity or ambiguous LED, stop immediately and preserve evidence. The qualified operator follows the signed feed/PSU recovery to restore the original full-redundancy configuration and verifies platform health; do not repeat the state, swap feeds or retry automatically.
